## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #184 implements the orchestrator-integration slice from issue #183, under parent plan #170.
- It adds `review -> agent-self-approve` when review synthesis is `SHIP` and `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true`.
- It adds `agent-self-approve -> fix-pr` for `REQUEST_CHANGES`, preserves handoff context, and extends delegated authorization checks only when self-approval is enabled.
- The change also updates docs, prompts, workflow inputs, and focused tests for the new route.

## Review
The implementation matches most of the requested routing and authorization design, and the rubrics review passed. However, one workflow condition prevents terminal self-approval results from re-entering the orchestrator, which conflicts with the parent orchestration model.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Self-approval terminal results bypass orchestrator handback | BLOCKING | `.github/workflows/agent-self-approve.yml` dispatches the orchestrator only for `request_changes`. Orchestrated `approved`, `blocked`, and `failed` self-approval runs can stop locally without terminal child reporting or parent resumption. |

## Progress
- Existing PR discussion had no inline review comments before synthesis.
- Posted one new inline comment on `.github/workflows/agent-self-approve.yml:178`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/184#discussion_r3212067568
- No replies were added and no comments were minimized.
- Claude and rubrics reviewers found no blockers; their INFO notes are optional cleanup/test hardening, not required branch changes.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Self-approval terminal results bypass orchestrator handback</summary>

**Cause:**  
The new `Orchestrate automation handoff` step is gated on `steps.result.outputs.conclusion == 'request_changes'`. That lets `REQUEST_CHANGES` reach `handoff.ts`, but prevents terminal `approved`, `blocked`, and `failed` conclusions from running `dispatch-agent-orchestrator.js` at all.

**Candidate solutions:**  
Dispatch the orchestrator for every successful self-approval resolver conclusion when `inputs.orchestration_enabled == 'true'`, then let `handoff.ts` decide whether to stop or route to `fix-pr`. Add focused coverage for an orchestrated terminal self-approval result proving terminal child reporting and parent resumption still happen.

**Comments:**  
Parent issue #170 explicitly includes terminal self-approval behavior in the integrated architecture. The disagreement is meaningful: one reviewer considered the PR shippable, but the blocking review is stronger because it identifies a concrete lost handback path in the changed workflow condition.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: the remaining issue is a concrete workflow/test change that is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

- [ ] Add regression coverage for an orchestrated terminal self-approval conclusion confirming terminal reporting/parent resumption still occurs.
